name: Vaya
note: Austrian alpine resort group (VAYA Hotels & Resorts, head office Innsbruck/Kematen in Tirol). Ownership not yet current-sourceable: an Oberländer Rundschau interview (7 May 2019, rundschau.at/landeck/wirtschaft/kann-das-nicht-nachvollziehen) names Frans Cornelis as 'geschäftsführender Gesellschafter' (managing shareholder) of the Vaya Group in Innsbruck, and mentions a family connection to tour operator Sunweb — but a 2019 statement needs a current source (Austrian company register or newer press) before a rating.
